title: Generalizing to the Future: Mitigating Entity Bias in Fake News Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the spurious correlations between specific named entities (e.g., people, locations, organizations) and news veracity labels. The bias is measured by comparing the performance of fake news detection models on future temporal data splits before and after applying a causal debiasing framework (ENDEF) that isolates and subtracts the direct predictive effect of entities.
